comment: M16 clubs: join up to maxJoin at the week 3 club fair. On a club's days its meeting takes your After School part (the weekly commitment) and gives its effects (stat XP, Bond with members) plus a short scene from 'lines'. firstScene plays at the first meeting.

clubs.name: Drama Club
clubs.blurb: Mr. Mustard's club. Monologues, stage fright, glitter.
lines: Mr. Mustard has you read a scene backwards 'for the vibe'. Priya nails it. You survive it.
Rehearsal. Kelly corrects everyone's blocking, including Mr. Mustard's. He lets her.
You build a cardboard moon. It's the best thing you've made all week.

clubs.name: Debate Club
clubs.blurb: Arguing, but with rules and a timer.
lines: Resolved: the cafeteria pizza is soup. Diane takes the affirmative and wins.
Theo argues both sides of a motion and loses to himself.
Mr. Mustard times you with an egg timer shaped like a chicken. You speak faster than you thought you could.

clubs.name: Cheer Squad
clubs.blurb: Coach Byrne's squad. Kelly runs it.
lines: Coach Byrne's whistle. Pyramids. Kara catches you, mostly.
Kelly drills the new routine until the sun goes orange. You can't feel your arms.
Kayla teaches you a chant. It's about the Hollow Mascot. Nobody remembers writing it.

clubs.name: Shop Club
clubs.blurb: Saws, sawdust and Mr. J's safety speech.
lines: Mr. J gives the safety speech. Then the safety speech about the safety speech.
Jake shows you a trick with a lathe that is definitely not in the manual.
Dex builds a tiny catapult. It works too well.

clubs.name: Art Club
clubs.blurb: Ms. Nonsense's art room. Paint everywhere, rules nowhere.
lines: Ms. Nonsense makes you paint with your wrong hand. It's better.
Mara draws the woods behind the school. There's a door in the drawing. She didn't draw a door.
Mel splatters a canvas and calls it 'Tuesday'. It's Wednesday.

clubs.name: Science Club
clubs.blurb: Ms. G's club. Experiments, tangents and small fires.
lines: Ms. G goes off on a tangent about magnets that somehow ends at the moon.
Penny measures something three times and still doesn't trust it.
Jon's volcano erupts early. The fire alarm agrees.
